name: SRG Housing Finance Ltd
title: SRG Housing Finance Ltd - 534680 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Small-ticket housing lender growing AUM 37% to INR 1,042 cr with GNPA 1.77% and CRAR 38.6%, but no capacity or supply-side signal; guidance of ~INR 600 cr disbursements and INR 1,300-1,400 cr AUM is management's own demand read.

triggers.label: FY27 disbursement target ~INR 600 cr
triggers.quote: we are targeting of approximately INR 600 crores of disbursement for this year

triggers.label: Cost of borrowing 10.88% → ~10.70%
triggers.quote: it may decline from 10.88% to around 10.70%

triggers.label: Mgmt contradicts itself on cost of borrowing
triggers.quote: Let us say for next one to two years, it will come down from 63% to 61%.

guidance.quote: we are targeting of approximately INR 600 crores of disbursement for this year
It will be around INR 1300 crores to INR 1400 crores
it may decline from 10.88% to around 10.70%
in the next two years, we want to cross it around INR 2000 crores

prior_guidance_check.quote: Earlier, you have actually guided about INR 500 crores of disbursement growth.

red_flags.label: Mgmt cost-of-borrowing guidance misstated on call (63% vs 10.88%) and corrected post-call
red_flags.quote: Note: Please note that on the con call, the cost of borrowing data was mentioned incorrectly

red_flags.label: Equity raise flagged as leverage nears 5x-6x
red_flags.quote: once our leverage crosses the 5x–6x range, we will certainly look at raising additional equity

red_flags.label: Rajasthan GNPA concentration questioned, answer deflected
red_flags.quote: the portfolio is quite big in Rajasthan when we compare it to other states

red_flags.label: Ticket size +41% with LTV rising 46.6% to 50.7%, explained as product nature
red_flags.quote: it is more about the nature of the product that we are into

evasions.quote: Sir, nothing in particular, if I say so, that there is no reason to it.

evasions.topic: Competition from larger lenders on ticket size
evasions.quote: Not really, sir, because the customer profile remains the same.
These averages work on a comparative basis.
